verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs say "Reframe handles every aspect ratio," and the API FAQ mentions outpainting a video to a different aspect ratio, so aspect-ratio conversion is a native capability rather than an external re-encode. 1080p output is documented only for Modify Video V2, and the pricing page lists a 360p Draft tier, so 1080p-or-above delivery for standard text/image-to-video generation is not shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of native 16:9/9:16/1:1 output presets, confirmed 1080p+ resolution for text/image-to-video generation, and hands-on or independent corroboration of channel-ready exports.
